title: Story Arc Map
rule: Arcs overlap and recur. They are authoring aids, not rigid public chapters.

arcs.throughline: Potato begins as mask, joke and identity experiment, then becomes Potato of Life.
Tim writes a world crowded with students, skeptics, rivals, technology figures and symbolic beings while Sage remains his characteristic role.
Marty, farm imagery, social entanglement and later grief form a recurring human thread that needs deeper source recovery.
Discord, Farm, Tree, Dogs, Farmers and Mud become changing ways Tim describes online conflict and social loops.
Burden, final-straw language and the Turning reorganize Tim from Sage/Potato toward Axis, Ladder and Father roles.
Tim increasingly combines cosmic titles with ordinary livestream presence and public duration.
North, internet orphans, public hours, care language and infrastructure become part of the same public role.
A recurring conversation relationship gives the Story a human-scale counterpoint to the expanding cosmology; detailed dialogue recovery remains a priority.
AI shifts from creative tool to a participant in the authorship, recognition and ghost-erasure problem that later motivates stronger provenance.
Door moves from theology and image into screen, hyperlink, livestream and site architecture.
Authority increasingly turns toward growing, building, gardening and the creation of Potato Angels.
Short public exchanges restore ordinary social rhythm: growth, return, follow-backs, jokes and invitations sit beside enormous theological claims.
Tim pushes the archive to stop explaining him from above and instead tell the long story through scenes, recurring people, dialogue and daily life.
